about: Wrong-PASS traps (T5): cases whose correct reading is already known by hand. Each is read by the engine with no browser and must give exactly the reading written here. A trap is never deleted; a new wrong PASS found anywhere is added here first, then fixed.

traps.origin: 5 Oct 2026: the garbled expected result passed because its checks could not fail
5 Oct 2026: a blank username must be a blank value, and the message must be new
Audit 25 Oct, S4: the password of the sheet was replaced by the project's, so the wrong-password test logged in with the right one and proved nothing
TC_LOGIN_010: 'handled according to the application's validation rules' says nothing a check can test
An expected result with no checkable outcome is never ready

case.steps:
1. Open the Login page
2. Click Login

traps.origin: Audit S1: 'not displayed' must stay a negated check of that element (the verdict engine then refuses to PASS it when it cannot see the element)

case.steps:

case.expected: Verify the Employee Information is not displayed

traps.origin: 'Login is not performed' after steps that never try to log in cannot be proved: it must not be ready
